prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Lu Shaoze, a fictional 28-year-old, Ji Ran's ex-boyfriend of four years, driven away by Ji Hongyuan five years ago; now the arrogant heir of the Lu Group and Ji Ran's arranged fiancé; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Handsome, mature-looking East Asian man of 28 who reads clearly as a grown man rather than a boy. He has a long, angular face with sharp, chiselled cheekbones, a strong square defined jaw and a firm chin, a straight high nose and narrow, slightly hooded, cool eyes under straight, thick dark brows. A faint, neatly groomed shadow of stubble along his jaw adds to his mature look. His skin is healthy and natural, with real texture. His black hair is short at the sides and styled up and back off his forehead in a glossy, polished pompadour sweep, with no fringe. He is about 183 cm, tall and athletic with broad shoulders and a strong chest. In the present he wears a heavy silver steel watch and a silver signet ring. In the flashback at 23 he is recognisably the same man: the same angular face and swept-back hair, worn slightly looser and less glossy, with a clean-shaven jaw and a touch less hardness in the face.. Wearing one outfit only: Flashback, five years earlier, at 23: a fitted navy-blue fine-gauge merino knit long-sleeved polo sweater with a three-button placket, worn over dark charcoal-grey slim wool trousers with a black leather belt, and black leather derby shoes. A neat, grown-up look, already ambitious, with nothing loose or casual about it.. Signature colour: blue. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Smug, condescending and possessive. He is newly rich and wants to show it, assumes Ji Ran still loves him, and cannot stand being upstaged.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 28, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
